# Subul Technology

> Software, AI and solar solutions company based in Iraq. Builds bilingual (Arabic/English) apps.

## Products

- [Watt (واط)](https://subultech.top/watt/): Watt sizes your solar system from your real location using PVGIS and NASA climate data, designs PV layouts, and connects you to a solar store and company quotations.
- [Baytraq](https://subultech.top/baytraq/): Manage sales, inventory, invoices, customer and supplier accounts and expenses in one app, with LAN or cloud device linking.
- [MEAAD (ميعاد Meaad)](https://subultech.top/meaad/): The easiest and most secure app to manage debts, installments, and subscriptions for your business.
- [MeterLog (ميتر لوغ)](https://subultech.top/meterlog/): AI-powered multimeter reader with OCR recognition, scheduled capture, and professional Excel/CSV export. Works 100% offline.
- [Madarik (مدارك)](https://subultech.top/madarik/): An engaging educational quiz game to test and expand your knowledge in Islamic history, science, geography, and more.
- [Store Management (إدارة المتجر)](https://subultech.top/store-management/): Your all-in-one solution for effortless store management. Track inventory, manage invoices, analyze sales, and stay connected with customers and suppliers.
- [SWEEP](https://subultech.top/sweep/): High-performance Mac cleaning utility for developers. Built with Rust, Tauri v2, and React. Automatically finds and removes hidden development artifacts to reclaim disk space.

## Watt (واط)

Watt sizes your solar system from your real location using PVGIS and NASA climate data, designs PV layouts, and connects you to a solar store and company quotations.

واط تحسب منظومتك الشمسية من موقعك الحقيقي ببيانات PVGIS وناسا، وتصمّم الألواح، وتربطك بمتجر الطاقة الشمسية وعروض أسعار الشركات.

- Website: https://subultech.top/watt/

### FAQ

**Is Watt the same app as Taqati?**
Yes. Taqati was renamed Watt. Your account and saved systems continue in the same app, and old Taqati links redirect to this page.

**Is Watt free?**
The calculators and design tools are free. Prices of products in the store are set by the sellers.

**Which countries does Watt support?**
The calculators work anywhere using PVGIS or NASA data. Iraq also has a built-in offline grid. Price estimates and store features appear for countries where they are available.

**Where do the solar numbers come from?**
From PVGIS (European Commission, JRC) first, then NASA POWER if PVGIS is unreachable, and a built-in grid for Iraq when you are offline. Each result shows its source.

**Can I rely on the results to buy equipment?**
Results are engineering estimates for planning. Confirm the final design and safety items such as wiring and breakers with a qualified technician before installing.

**Does Watt need my location?**
Only if you allow it, to fetch the sun at your site. You can also pick a place on the map or skip it and get a clearly labelled general estimate.

**How do I delete my account?**
From your account page inside the app, or by following the steps on the account deletion page.
